Interpretation
ER / PR   ASCO/ CAP Guidelines on HER2 and Hormone Receptors Testing In Breast Cancer, 2010
Estrogen and Progesterone Receptor Evaluation

Positive For ER/ PgR  If finding of >=1 of tumor cell nuclei are Immunoreactive
Negative for ER or PgR  If finding of < 1 or tumor cell nuclei are Immunoreactive ( Positive Intrinsic Controls are seen )
Uninterpretable  Controls display unexpected result or prenalytic and analytic conditions do not confirm to the guidelines.

 

HER-2/Neu  
Negative (Score 0 )   No staining observed or Membrane staining that is incomplete and is faint/ barely perceptible and within <= 10% of tumor cells.
Negative (Score 1+)   Incomplete, faint . barely perceptible membrane staining in >=10% of invasive tumor cells
Equivocal (Score 2+)**   Incomplete, faint . barely perceptible membrane staining in >=10% of tumor cells   OR Complete, intense. Circumferential membrane staining in <= 10% of tumor cells
Positive (Score 3+)   Complete, intense. Circumferential membrane staining in > 10% of tumor cells

 ** Her2 by FISH required. May be tested with fresh sample.

Limitation of Procedure: Disclaimer is given due to following factors in ER, PR and Her2 neu testing and results-
1. Tissue processing and handling prior to immunostaining can cause inconsistant results.
2. Prolonged fixation time in formalin / prolonged cold ischaemia time will affect these biomarker results.
3. Variations in fixation and embedding of tissue may cause variation in results.
4. Inherent nature of the tissue may cause variations in results.
5. Type of fixative, if other than buffered formalin, decalcification can alter immunoreactivity.
6. Triple negative may result from over fixation in formalin or prolonged cold ischaemia time of tissue. Repeat with fresh biopsy may be resorted to for appropriate results, if applicable.
